mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1939/${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}; gh pr diff 1939 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1939/${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}/diff.patch | grep -c '^diff --git'
